description: This file contains utility functions for safe navigation within an Android app using Jetpack Navigation components. It provides extended functionality to NavController to prevent crashes due to rapid repeated navigation commands by checking destination state before executing navigation requests.

methods.name: navigateSafely
methods.description: Safely navigates to a destination specified by NavDirections, checking current destination to prevent crashes from rapid repeated calls.

methods.name: navigateSafely
methods.description: Overloaded function that navigates directly by destination ID with optional arguments and navigation options.
